facts.business: Shree Ganesh Remedies Limited is a chemistry-driven manufacturer of pharmaceutical intermediates and speciality and fine chemicals, serving pharmaceutical, agrochemical, polymer and electronics industries across more than 20 countries.
facts.related_party_note: The Company is in compliance with Sections 177 and 188 of the Act for all transactions with related parties and details have been disclosed in the Standalone Financial Statements as required by applicable accounting standards.
